newsitem.title: USA: USG jet fuel diffs weaken in lackluster trading.
newsitem.headline: USG jet fuel diffs weaken in lackluster trading.

text.p: U.S. Gulf (USG) jet fuel differentials weakened slightly in thin conditions, with many players out of the market following Wednesday's industry outing.
On NYMEX, June heating oil futures shed 0.59 cents by the settlement.
USG 54-grade jet fuel for delivery on the back 13th cycle of the Colonial Pipeline was offered at 1.15 cents under the screen, down about 0.15 cent from Wednesday levels.
The 54-grade in NYH was talked in wide range, with no reports of barrels changing hands emerging. Bids for prompt barrels sat near 2.50 cents over the screen, while offers were near 4.00 cents over.
